issue_detail.value: A high-risk unit's second review seat defaults to engineering, the seat that built it, so the engineering brief's printed record command is a self-review - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane land's commit timeout kills git but leaves the hooks' test run running orphaned, holding the host's CPU after the land reports nothing committed - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane accept records a second seat's verdict against the unit's saved qa brief, not the brief the verdict file names - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

sprint drive and drive step: an oversized brief exits 2 after work ran, a refused paperwork commit re-runs to exit 0, any agent id is accepted as the reviewer, and several guards have no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
Flaky: test_lane_run's timed-out git add test can find index.lock left behind on the gate host - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

The recorded runner report and the replayed mutants: a -k 'a or b' selector prints bogus ids, a malformed kept list crashes the brief, a failed list write is reported as nothing written, and several checks have no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
drive step names lane accept as the resume of a warning stop at accept, which lane accept refuses because the verdict is already recorded - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
When lane land's bound on critic.py brief fires, critic is killed and the mutation runner its replay started is left running - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

critic.py record escapes a verdict's underscores but not its asterisks, so a ledger row reads a glob such as `name_*` or `other_*` as emphasis and markdownlint (MD037) refuses the commit - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

The session meter finds a Claude Code session's transcript store from the session id the harness exports, so a run driven from another repository is priced without SDLC_STUDIO_TRANSCRIPTS - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

gate.py --red-run's regression path over-claims: a failing id that names no file files no bug, and a second red on a different test reuses the first bug without naming that test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

Two of gate.py --red-run's behaviours hold by probe but no test pins them: the sections after a bug's CI Red Runs section, and the refusal of a negative, boolean or fractional rerun limit - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
ci.wait_timeout_minutes has no reader: the trunk guidance's wait fence hardcodes `timeout 30m`, so a project's override changes nothing - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
mutation.py run --edits counts an edit that does not compile as killed and exits 0, and silently ignores --format and --max-mutations - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane land's several-worktree landing moves a body line shaped like a trailer into the trailers, and three of its refusals have no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
lane land --resume compares unit ids as raw strings, a landing stopped at rebase records no commit, and two refusals have no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
The plan's unmetered warning gives a false reason on a re-plan, one of its test assertions cannot fail, and a fallback sentence is reached by no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
sprint sign prints nothing when its retro write fails, so a mistyped --retro id now reaches that silence, and the close tail still prefers the scaffolded retro - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator

The verbatim repair brief loses the first-line indentation of a REJECT finding written over several lines, and its newest-landing choice and superseded filter have no test - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
The TRD's table of committed records does not list the author mutant lists that critic.py self-check record now keeps under sdlc-studio/reviews/author-mutants/ - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
critic.py record has no check mode, so a reviewer cannot confirm its verdict file will record before handing back - not-stop-ship, ruled by orchestrator
